audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Skill at levels 4-5 and 6, but whys[3] says ranking the combo keeps your dodge-stun up and your blob denial working, and whys[4] says level 6 'turns the extended duel into a clean kill'. The packet chart (Skill, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax) matches the prose.
audit.why: Zac is a tank with no scaling carry threat, so once Jax has the full pattern there is no row that flips back to him — the 56.12% win rate and the page's own late section both say Jax owns the 1v1 all game.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 set to Jax in both layers as one atomic group, ratings raised to 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate is written "Grandmaster at Arms" in whys[4], spikes[1].text and late.
audit.why: The ability is Grandmaster's Might, 110/100/90s; phases[4].why already uses the correct name, and wants.you[2] gets it half-right as 'Grandmaster's'.
audit.corrected: Renamed in the three prose strings. Zac's spike structure is unchanged and correct: his only real windows are a charged Elastic Slingshot and the level 6 teamfight ult, not a scaling item timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unstable Matter is called 'his pulse' throughout with no cooldown and no mention that it deals a percentage of your maximum health, and Elastic Slingshot's cooldown is never given.
audit.why: This is the interaction that defines the matchup and the mirror audit already established it: Counter Strike dodges attacks, so autos are wasted into it but Unstable Matter ticks straight through, every 5 seconds, for percent max health — which also means building HP makes it worse. Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 against Counter Strike's 17s, so once he spends it you have a window longer than your own cooldown. Those two numbers turn the page's advice from 'bait his cooldown' into a plan.
audit.corrected: Unstable Matter's 5s cooldown and percent-max-health damage added to whys[0] and mid; Elastic Slingshot's 21s added to dosFull[0].d. Restated from the mirror audit rather than re-derived.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zac.json W cd 5 with percentHealth, E cd 21/18/15/12/9, Q cd 14/12.5/11/9.5/8

audit.why: The page already gets the hard part right — that Counter Strike does NOT eat Zac's rotation the way it shuts down an auto-attacker — and says so explicitly in early, mid and spikes[3]. It also correctly avoids the bogus claim that Elastic Slingshot grounds Leap Strike. Per the mirror audit, Zac's E carries a false 'grounding' flag from Riot's phrase 'attaches his arms to the ground', and Jax's Empower carries a false 'dash' flag from 'charges his weapon'; I asserted neither.
audit.corrected: Four packet suspectNames were checked: 'Stretching Strike' should be Stretching Strikes and 'Let's Bounce' should be Let's Bounce! — both corrected. 'Unstable Matter's' and 'Leap Strike-' are false positives from a possessive and a hyphen.

edits.before: This is your window. Bait the cooldown — let him throw Unstable Matter or a slingshot, then Leap Strike onto him with Empower loaded and Counter Strike held; even though E won't dodge his spells, the stun on recast still locks him while you out-stat him, and stepping on his blobs means none of the trade heals back. At 6 your R's armor-MR steroid plus the every-third-hit on-hit ramp ends any extended duel — he's a tank with no burst to race you, so commit fully when your combo is up and his Slingshot is on cooldown.
edits.after: This is your window. Bait the slingshot — 21s at rank 1 is longer than your own E — then Leap Strike onto him with Empower loaded and Counter Strike held; E won't dodge his spells, but the recast stun still locks him while you out-stat him, and stepping on his blobs means none of the trade heals back. Unstable Matter keeps ticking through all of it every 5s for percent max health, so don't answer it by stacking HP. At 6 your R's armor-MR steroid plus the every-third-hit on-hit ramp ends any extended duel — he has no burst to race you.

edits.before: You own the 1v1 all game here — Zac is a tank, not a scaling carry, so unlike Kayle or Vayne he never reclaims the late game from you, and Grandmaster at Arms keeps you ahead in every side-lane duel. His only real threat is the map: a charged Elastic Slingshot flank or his Let's Bounce knockup catching your team in a fight. Keep stepping on his blobs to deny sustain, hold anti-heal for when his tank items come online, and don't facecheck brush where a charged slingshot can pin you.

notes: Mirror reused rather than re-derived: I took the Counter-Strike-versus-Unstable-Matter finding straight from audits/top/zac__jax and restated it from Jax's side, and I followed its warning not to repeat the _missing-interactions claim that Elastic Slingshot grounds Leap Strike — Zac's E carries a bogus grounding flag from Riot's phrase 'attaches his arms to the ground', and Empower carries a bogus dash flag from 'charges his weapon'. I did not use the mirror's other key point ('his R adds Armor and MR') because Zac's R in the kit grants only knockup and slow, with no resists in Riot's text; if that line is on the Zac page it may need checking there. Zac's passive revive on fatal damage is in the kit but nowhere on this page — the blob-denial advice covers half of it, but nothing warns you that killing him can fail outright. Worth a follow-up.
